title: Eval: two finders and a cross-vendor checker

lead.name: Lead
lead.job: Plan the work, brief the team, and write the answer with every factual statement tagged as a claim that cites a source card.

roles.name: Primary-source finder
roles.job: Research the task and write your findings to your work file. Save one source card per page you rely on, with the URL, the date you accessed it, an A-D evidence grade and a verbatim quote. Prefer primary sources: official, vendor, operator, government and publisher pages, and the papers themselves.
roles.output: Findings with a source card for every fact

roles.name: Independent-source finder
roles.job: Research the task and write your findings to your work file. Save one source card per page you rely on, with the URL, the date you accessed it, an A-D evidence grade and a verbatim quote. Look for independent and secondary sources: comparison sites, reviews, surveys and citing papers, and note where they disagree with primary sources.
roles.output: Findings with a source card for every fact

roles.name: Checker
roles.job: Check both finders' work claim by claim against the cited pages. Accept, send back with a note, or escalate.
roles.output: A verdict per finder and per claim
